text:
leah_cs: Heads-up  VelaGrid renewal in 8 days. Procurement wants split billing (VelaGrid US + VelaGrid UK), a 6-month term instead of annual, and onboarding to start once PO is uploaded. Need pricing + legal alignment.
ben_sales: looping in @dina_legal @sam_fin. Any quick blockers?
dina_legal: We can support multi-entity billing but the SOW must include separate billing lines and a tax appendix. For 'start-on-PO' we need an explicit PO acceptance clause limiting pre-onboarding to view/reserved seats.
sam_fin: Finance note: 6mo proration ≈54% of annual. To protect margin propose +4% uplift on the prorated subtotal. Also need vendor code mapping and PO number on invoices.
olivia_onboard: We can run pre-kickoff workshops and reserve 2 enablement seats. Full SSO and production seat activation must wait for signed contract or PO with acceptance clause.
ben_sales: Customer replied at 1761234805: willing to accept 6mo +4% and keep 2 onboarding credits. They expect to upload PO today and provided vendor code VELA-UK.
leah_cs: I'll prepare DocuSign amendment and PO template and mark this row non-standard in the tracker.
renewal-bot: Reminder  renewal:velagrid in 8 days. Actions: pricing approval, DocuSign amendment, PO template.

---

```
Billing Line A:
- Entity: VelaGrid, Inc. (EIN: 11-2223334)

- Scope: UK seats
Vendor code: VELA-UK
Payment terms: Net30 (PO required). Please include PO# on invoice.
```

ben_sales: Sent DocuSign link and PO template at 1761235000 (internal id: RENEW-1761). Will follow up EOD if PO not uploaded. :thumbsup:
